summary: Added an explicit approved-plan materialization hook to the existing V11 private ingress without creating new scheduling authority. APPROVED envelopes enter the existing Capture -> Page Change WORKER_POOL -> sanitized wake path with stable approval correlation; rejected/ambiguous envelopes fail before transport; same-browser exact replay is deduplicated and approval-id/digest conflict fails closed. Source-level tests pass. Remaining gates are UI wiring, server/cross-device replay dedupe, and a served authenticated end-to-end canary; therefore runtime completion is not claimed.
